def: a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma

occurrences.text: And there went out unto him all the land of Judea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
